meta.name: playwright-cli
meta.description: Automate browser interactions, test web pages and work with Playwright tests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动化浏览器交互与网页测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码操控浏览器并验证网页行为
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and test web pages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically and verify web page behavior

howto.what: 启用后,Claude 可以打开真实浏览器访问网页,执行点击、输入、翻页、填表等操作,从页面快照里判断结果,还能运行和调试 Playwright 测试。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 操作网页、测试网页功能、处理 Playwright 测试,或征求你对页面的 UI 意见时触发。

say.text: 帮我打开 example.com,点一下登录按钮。
say.note: 它会先开浏览器,再从快照里找按钮点击。

say.text: 打开这个网页,截一张图给我。
say.note: 会保存截图文件并附上当前页面快照。

say.text: 跑一下这个 Playwright 测试,失败就查原因。
say.note: 会执行测试并输出控制台与网络请求信息。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude can open a real browser, visit pages, click, type, fill forms, navigate, inspect page snapshots, and run/debug Playwright tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to operate a webpage, test a page, work with Playwright tests, or get your UI feedback.

say_en.text: Open example.com and click the login button.
say_en.note: It opens a browser and clicks the button from the snapshot.

say_en.text: Open this page and take a screenshot for me.
say_en.note: Saves a screenshot and gives you the page snapshot.

say_en.text: Run this Playwright test and debug any failure.
say_en.note: Executes the test and shows console and network request output.
